text: Coding rules come in several forms. Later in this lesson, we'll study each one separately: Letter coding: letters are replaced by other letters. Number coding: letters or words are represented by numbers. Symbol coding: letters or digits are replaced by symbols. Substitution coding: one word is called by another word's name. Mixed coding: words in a sentence share codes, and you must match them. All of these depend on one skill: fast, accurate handling of the alphabet. So before we solve anything, let's build the toolkit.
